visa_extension.title: Visa extension
visa_extension.description: Work through the documents and steps you need before your visa expires.

steps.title: Check your visa expiry date
steps.description: Check the expiry dates on your passport and residence card.

steps.title: Request school documents
steps.description: Ask the international office for your enrollment certificate and transcript.

steps.title: Prepare proof of funds
steps.description: Prepare a bank balance certificate and other required documents.

steps.title: Book an immigration appointment
steps.description: Book online via HiKorea or in person.

steps.title: Apply and pay the fee
steps.description: Fill in the application form and pay the fee.

settling_korea.title: Settling in Korea
settling_korea.description: Set up the basics for daily life after you arrive.

steps.title: Apply for alien registration
steps.description: You must apply within 90 days of arrival.

steps.title: Get a phone plan
steps.description: Open a number that can be used for identity verification.

steps.title: Open a bank account
steps.description: Open an account with your residence card.

steps.title: Check health insurance
steps.description: Check whether you must join National Health Insurance.

moving.title: Moving
moving.description: A checklist for moving to a new place.

steps.title: Set your budget and area
steps.description: Decide your monthly rent and deposit budget and preferred area.

steps.title: Search for listings
steps.description: Use licensed agents or school-recommended channels to avoid scams.

steps.title: Review the contract
steps.description: Check the deposit, termination terms and maintenance fees.

steps.title: Register your new address
steps.description: Update the address on your alien registration after moving.

job_prep.title: Job preparation
job_prep.description: Steps to prepare for a job, internship or part-time work.

steps.title: Check what your visa allows
steps.description: Check the work conditions for your status, such as D-2 or D-10.

steps.title: Update your résumé and portfolio
steps.description: Prepare Korean and English versions.

steps.title: Talk to a mentor
steps.description: Book a session with a mentor in your field.

steps.title: Prepare applications and interviews
steps.description: Add your application deadlines to the calendar.

d10_prep.title: D-10 job-seeker visa
d10_prep.description: A roadmap for switching to a job-seeker visa after graduation.

steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.description: Check your degree, graduation requirements and length of stay.

steps.title: List required documents
steps.description: Organize the documents required by your school and immigration.

steps.title: Plan your job search
steps.description: Set your target roles and timeline.

steps.title: Book your application date
steps.description: Schedule your application well before your visa expires.
